summary: The Level 2/3 Reiki Healing Course follows our Level 1&2 course and is designed for people who want to go deeper and use Reiki to help others in more specific and advanced ways.
intro: At Bali Yoga School, we believe healing is not something outside, but something you already carry inside. Our Level 2/3 Reiki Healing Course is the next level after our Level 1&2 Reiki Healing Course in Ubud, Bali, designed for people who want to go deeper and use Reiki not only for themselves but also for helping other people in more specific and advanced ways.

Reiki Healing is an energy healing method that helps to balance body, mind and spirit. It comes from Japan, and the word “Rei” means universal wisdom while “Ki” means life force energy. A Reiki healer transfers this energy by gently placing hands on or just above the body.

In the Level 2/3 course, you will also learn advanced methods – such as Reiki symbols, distant healing, and how to guide the energy for specific needs. This makes you able to use Reiki not just for self-care, but also to support healing for other people.

policies.title: Refund Policy
items: Deposits are non-refundable, but can be transferred to other upcoming courses at Bali Yoga School in any locations. The deposit is valid for a lifetime.

policies.title: Management Authority
items: The management team is authorised to make the necessary changes in the daily schedule if needed. These adjustments ensure smooth coordination of classes and the best experience for all participants.

policies.title: Course Booking & Confirmation
items: To book for the course, please deposit the complete course fees of 100 USD. An official confirmation letter for your program will be sent shortly after successful payment of the yoga retreat fees.

policies.title: Asanas Class
items: The purpose of the asana classes is to support your body and mind in the healing process during your healing course journey. These sessions promote personal well-being rather than provide professional-level training in asanas or alignment techniques.

policies.title: 1 Hour Self Practice
items: You can engage in a one-hour self-practice session in the HYA Healing Studio using available instruments. Any damage to equipment during practice must be covered by you.

policies.title: Important Note
items: The school reserves the right to change the timings of the classes if it is needed.

issues: Uluwatu copy on an Ubud page: 'Ubud is not only famous for its high cliffs and ocean view', 'The ocean waves, high cliffs, and peaceful temples' (Ubud is inland), dates note 'We offer the Level 2/3 Reiki Healing Course in Uluwatu, Bali throughout the year', and schedule item 'Sunrise Flow & Meditation on the Cliff'. Schedule, meal times (breakfast 9:30, lunch 1 pm) and 'Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays' may also be Uluwatu-campus details — confirm for Ubud (other Ubud healing pages list breakfast 8:30 am, lunch 12:30 pm, 'Hatha Vinyasa Yoga & Meditation' 6–7 am).
Daily schedule conflict: 'Sunrise Flow & Meditation on the Cliff 6:30–8:30 am' overlaps 'Balinese Massage Treatment 7:00–8:00 am' on Days 2–4.

No completion certificate item in 'What's Included' (other pages list 'Level X Reiki Healing Completion Certification'); only 'certified by International Yoga Organisation & Himalayan Yoga Association Yoga Society'.
Refund policy (deposits non-refundable, transferable, valid for a lifetime) appears only on this page among Ubud Reiki pages — confirm it applies site-wide.
Booking text is self-contradictory: 'deposit the complete course fees of 100 USD' and refers to 'yoga retreat fees'.
Self-practice policy refers to 'HYA Healing Studio' 'using available instruments' — copied from sound healing / Rishikesh text.

Unverified marketing claims omitted: 'one of the top-leading yoga and healing school in Bali', 'Our reputation comes from thousands of students who transform their life with us', 'Many students from around the world already come here and transform their life', 'teachers ... are certified Reiki Masters' (teachers not individually stated as Reiki Masters).

Fee labels for Private Room Campus-I/II omit '(All Inclusive)' — unclear whether meals are included (twin is labelled 'All-inclusive').
Inclusions say '3 daily vegetarian meals' while dining text says 'Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays' — conflicts if a course spans a Sunday.
